o1.biggest_mistake: It spends the fifth email on sharing, even though the owner's own data says shared projects are weaker and the private notes explicitly want the team invite dropped rather than kept in a softer form.

reason: Output 2 is much closer to what I'd actually run: it follows the brand better, uses the available triggers realistically, and puts the highest-leverage actions first. Output 1 understands the data but loses me by keeping a sharing email when the clearest signal was to drop that path.
